required_work.semantics: Translates software engineering requirements into domain-neutral WorkContract with tolerance

candidate_machinery.semantics: Proposes atomic candidate machinery nodes to eliminate detected software deficiencies

factor_grammar.semantics: Factors software work into literal 6D coordinates and audits for compliance/drift

certify.semantics: Evaluates software components through 5-gate software boundary C_sw = { T, U, S, L, F } or machinery candidates through 4-gate kernel boundary

measure_ability.semantics: Measures solve capability for a software requirement given current certified state

invariants.kernel_immutability: H(K_before) = H(K_after) across all shared kernel and substrate subsystems
invariants.math_immutability: H(D_math_before) = H(D_math_after) across mathematics domain subsystem
invariants.physics_immutability: H(D_phys_before) = H(D_phys_after) across physics domain subsystem
invariants.zero_domain_leakage: No imports of mapeogeo.domains in kernel, grammar, graph, psmsl, routing, or proof
